title: Administrators in every project chat, smoother scorecard

items.title: Administrators can join any project chat
items.body: Administrators now see Team chat on every project, not only the ones they lead or belong to, and can read and post there. Their messages show their name. New-message alerts still go to the project team only.

items.title: Smoother scorecard trends
items.body: The small trend lines on the Home scorecard are now smooth curves with a soft shade underneath, and a dot marks where things stand today.

title: Our Daily Bread on Home, and your profile in the menu

items.title: Our Daily Bread every day
items.body: The Verse of the Day is now today's key verse from Our Daily Bread. Tap Read more for the full devotional: the picture, today's scripture, Bible in a Year, the audio to listen to, the devotion, Reflect & Pray and Today's Insights. Go back to earlier days, and share your own reflection on today's.

items.title: Your profile in the menu
items.body: On phones and tablets, your picture, name and status are now at the top of the menu (☰), under PRISM. Tap it for your profile and settings; they open over the menu, so nothing moves.

items.title: Tidier project chat
items.body: The message box lines up neatly, and Team chat fits beside the project's status on phones.

items.title: Louder sign-in music
items.body: The sign-in music is easier to hear. The speaker button still turns it off on this device.

title: Team chat for ongoing projects

items.title: Chat with your project team
items.body: Open a project you're on and tap Team chat. Only the project's lead and members can read and post, and messages arrive straight away. You can see who's typing, reply to a message, delete your own, and add emoji or GIFs. When a project is no longer ongoing, its chat stays readable but nobody can post.

items.title: Chat notifications
items.body: A new message rings your bell once per chat, not once per message. Tap it to open that chat; opening it clears the notification.

items.title: +10 XP for checking in
items.body: Claim 10 XP on Home once a day. It counts toward your level like finished tasks.

items.title: New tasks pop up
items.body: When someone gives you tasks, a pop-up lets you accept each one or look at them later in My Day.

items.title: Neater status dot and badges
items.body: Your status dot now sits in a clean notch on your picture. Badges on your profile show five at first, with Show all for the rest.

items.title: Light mode fixes
items.body: Pressed filter chips and level names are easier to read in light mode, and the map keeps its dark look.

title: New music on the sign-in screen

items.title: New sign-in music
items.body: The sign-in screen has a new song, mixed so the voice comes through clearly and the opening isn’t too quiet. It still starts softly, and the speaker button turns it off on this device.

title: Several tasks at once, tidier files and forms

items.title: Choose several tasks at once
items.body: On a phone, press and hold a task; on a computer, tap Select, or Shift-click to pick every task between two. Then mark them done, plan them for today or remove them together. Tasks someone else gave you stay theirs to change: those are skipped, and you're told how many.

items.title: Give one task to several people
items.body: When you add a task, tick everyone it's for under Assigned to. Each person gets their own copy to accept, start and finish, and you see each one in Given to others.

items.title: Finished tasks on the Home calendar
items.body: A green dot marks each day a task was finished. Tap the day to see who finished what. Amber is due and red is overdue, always in that order, with a key under the month.

items.title: Started, finished and how long it took
items.body: A person's task timeline now shows when each task was started and finished, and how long it took between them. A task under way shows how long so far.

items.title: Files first in Documentation and Resources
items.body: Filters fold into one Filters button that opens a sheet, with the ones that are on shown as small chips. View, Select and Change folder are under the ⋯ menu. To select, press and hold a file on a phone, or Shift-click or Ctrl-click on a computer.

items.title: A clearer Forms toolbar
items.body: Text size and side margins have their own tidy controls, with big presets on phones in a bottom sheet, and Print stays the one main button. On phones the controls sit at the bottom, under your thumb.

title: Steadier screens on your phone

items.title: Sign-in that stays put
items.body: A mistake now shows in the field's own label, and a wrong password shows at the top of the screen, so the boxes and the Sign in button never jump. With quick unlock, your fingerprint comes first; the PIN shows when you ask for it or the fingerprint doesn't work.

items.title: A cleaner profile
items.body: Your status is the dot on your picture, like the rest of the portal. Saving shows a clear confirmation. Your position is set by an administrator, on the Staff page; until then your profile shows your role.

items.title: Less clutter
items.body: The Online label is gone (the green dot says it), today's date shows only on Home, and Home no longer has the overview row. The status picker in the account menu opens as a small card, so nothing under it moves.

items.title: A steady page behind the menu
items.body: On phones, the page behind the navigation menu no longer scrolls while the menu is open.

title: More XP and a smoother start

items.title: +50 XP for finishing Get started
items.body: Finish every step of Get started and 50 XP goes to your progress, once. A full working week, a task finished every day Monday to Friday, now earns 50 XP instead of 25.

items.title: Your week on Home
items.body: The My tasks card on Home shows this week's circles, Monday to Sunday, with a check on each day you finished a task.

items.title: Change your status from your picture
items.body: In the account menu, tap your picture with its status dot to pick Online, Idle, Do Not Disturb or Invisible.

items.title: A calmer first sign-in
items.body: The first-time question now waits until the welcome closes, the tip on a computer stays clear of the Active panel, and on phones the Next step bar no longer covers the bottom of the page.

title: A smoother sign-in

items.title: A calmer, smoother background
items.body: The red relief-work collage now drifts slowly under very fine sand grain, with a warm glow and a soft band of light now and then. It loads faster and stays smooth on phones.

items.title: Just the prism
items.body: The sign-in screen shows only the PRISM triangle with its P, a little bigger, still with its beam of light, spectrum and turning ring.

title: A brighter sign-in and a welcome every time

items.title: The PRISM logo comes alive
items.body: On the sign-in screen a beam of white light shoots into the prism and leaves as a red, amber and gold spectrum, inside a slowly turning ring of light.

items.title: A cleaner background
items.body: The relief-work collage now has very fine grain that glides smoothly, with thin blades of light slicing through it.

items.title: Welcome, every time
items.body: The welcome now greets you after every sign-in.

title: A livelier sign-in background

items.title: Our work, lit up one photo at a time
items.body: The sign-in screen has a new, brighter collage of PHILRADS relief work. It drifts slowly, one photo at a time softly lights up, grain hovers over it and warm specks float up. On a computer it leans a little toward your mouse. It stays still if your device is set to reduce motion.

title: A new look for the sign-in screen

items.title: Our work, behind the sign-in
items.body: The sign-in screen now shows a collage of PHILRADS relief work that drifts slowly, warmed from burgundy to amber, with a soft light moving from photo to photo. It stays still if your phone is set to reduce motion.

items.title: Cleaner sign-in fields
items.body: The faint box that showed under the email and password fields is gone.

title: Kinder sign-in, clearer badges, livelier taps

items.title: A kinder sign-in
items.body: Labels stay in view and float up as you type. A mistake shows only when you leave the field, and it clears as soon as you type again; a valid email gets a green check right away. If something is missing when you press Sign in, a short list at the top takes you to each field.

items.title: The bell counts what needs you
items.body: A red number means something waits on your decision, like a task offered to you or a release to approve. A yellow dot means there's only news. Counts stop at 99+, and each note shows a single red or yellow dot.

items.title: Taps you can feel
items.body: Buttons sink when you press and spring back when you let go. Pulling down to refresh stretches and resists more the further you pull. Dragging a subtask lifts it, the others move aside, and it springs into its new place. Saved and sent messages draw a green check.

items.title: Messages stay on top
items.body: “Kudos sent” and other messages now show in full above any open sheet, instead of hiding behind it.

items.title: No automatic sign-out for now
items.body: The portal no longer signs you out or locks after a few idle minutes.

title: An accepted task stays accepted everywhere

items.title: No more asking twice
items.body: When you accept or decline a task, from Tasks, Home, your Active panel or a bell note, every other place updates at once, so none of them keeps asking you to accept it. Opening a task from the bell always shows how it stands now, even if you answered it on another device.

title: A task timeline, a green check and a quicker code

items.title: Everyone's tasks as a timeline
items.body: Tap a person in Active to see their tasks on a timeline: done work first, then what's under way and what's next by due date. The line fills up to where they are, the task they're working on glows, and late ones are marked in red.

items.title: A green check when it's done
items.body: Finished tasks and ticked subtasks now get a green check that pops in and draws itself.

items.title: The email code in six boxes
items.body: Volunteers signing in type the emailed code into six boxes. Paste the whole code at once, or let your phone suggest it from the email; it signs you in as soon as the last digit is in.

items.title: Office tasks skip the List
items.body: When a new task is Office work, the List choice greys out, since lists are for field work.

items.title: Clearer buttons
items.body: Buttons now say what they do, each screen has one main button, and buttons keep their size while they work.

title: The music starts on your first tap

items.title: Sign-in music that starts
items.body: Phones and browsers hold sound back until you tap. The PRISM theme now starts on your first tap anywhere on the sign-in screen (the speaker button says “Tap for music” until then), and it plays each time the screen opens.

items.title: Sounds on phones
items.body: Notification and error sounds now get the phone's permission on your first tap, so they play reliably.

title: A new PRISM logo, and updates that install themselves

items.title: A new PRISM logo
items.body: The triangle is the prism: white light goes in and comes out as a spectrum of red, amber and gold, with the P of PRISM in PHILRADS maroon inside. You'll see it in the menu, on the sign-in screen and as the app icon (on some phones the home-screen icon changes after you remove the app and add it again).

items.title: Always the latest PRISM
items.body: PRISM now checks for a new version from the sign-in screen on, every 15 minutes and whenever you come back to it, and installs it on its own when nothing can be lost: before you sign in, right after opening, or when you return after a while. In the middle of your work it still asks first.

title: The P lights up

items.title: A red P in PRISM
items.body: The P in PRISM is now PHILRADS red. On the sign-in screen it lights up first, then R, I, S and M fan out after it like light leaving the prism, and the P keeps a slow glow.

items.title: The theme keeps playing
items.body: The PRISM theme on the sign-in screen now loops for as long as the screen is open. The speaker button still turns it off.

title: The PRISM theme

items.title: Music on the sign-in screen
items.body: The PRISM theme plays softly when the sign-in screen opens and fades out when you sign in. The speaker button in the corner turns it off on your device.

items.title: Tidier volunteer and guest buttons
items.body: “Volunteer” and “Guest” are now two even tiles under the sign-in form, each saying what it does.

title: Glass, a new chime and a safer timeout

items.title: Automatic sign-out is back
items.body: Administrators, coordinators and staff are signed out after 5 minutes without activity, with a one-minute “Still there?” warning first. With a PIN or fingerprint set up, the portal locks instead. Sharing your live location keeps you signed in.

items.title: A glassier PRISM
items.body: The PRISM header on the sign-in and guest pages is now frosted maroon glass, with slow drifting light, a sheen that sweeps across and a glow that follows your finger.

items.title: A new notification sound
items.body: New notes in the bell now play a fresh chime. You can still switch it off in your account menu.

title: Volunteers sign in with a code

items.title: Volunteer sign-in
items.body: Volunteers tap “I’m a volunteer” and sign in with a 6-digit code sent to their email. No password to remember. They see the Live Map, Tasks, Forms, PDM and Documentation.

items.title: Your task, your call
items.body: Only the person who gave a task can change, reassign, send back or remove it. Other coordinators can step in only if that person’s account is no longer active.

items.title: A peek for guests
items.body: “Continue as guest” shows what’s coming for visitors: the Live Map, Disaster News, PHILReads, Donation Drives, Merch and Feedback.

title: Task lists follow our programs

items.title: Lists named like Statistics
items.body: Task lists are now the six PHILRADS programs: Emergency response, Rehabilitation and recovery, Sustainable livelihood, Training and capacity building, Special projects, and Monitoring and coordination. Your existing tasks moved to the matching program.

items.title: Badges by program
items.body: The list badges now follow the programs too: First responder, Eyes on the ground, Rebuilder, Change maker and Mentor.

items.title: My tasks on Home
items.body: A new box on Home shows tasks waiting for your answer, what's on today, and what's coming up. Tap one to open it.

items.title: Task requests are easier to find
items.body: Tapping a notification now opens the task. Tasks someone asks you to take on wait at the top of Today until you accept or decline.

items.title: A tidier menu
items.body: Staff Tasks sits under the Live Map, Response under Inventory, and Statistics at the end after Resources.

title: Clearer phones, a friendlier map

items.title: New map pins
items.body: Team members show with their picture in a ring and their first name; places are round badges with their name beside them once you zoom in. Show all places now frames everything you have switched on.

items.title: Tasks on your phone
items.body: Your views are now three tabs (Mine, Given, Team) with one short row underneath. Swipe a task right to finish it, or left to plan it for today.

items.title: Buttons in thumb reach
items.body: On phones, each page’s main button (New task, Upload, New project, Add resource, Invite) floats at the bottom right and steps aside while you scroll down.

items.title: Tidier filters
items.body: Documentation sorts into All, Media and Records on phones, and Resources categories are a single row you can slide.

items.title: Chat is gone, PDM is coming
items.body: The Chat placeholder has been removed. PDM is marked Coming soon.

title: See who’s on, and tasks for the whole team

items.title: Who’s active, at a glance
items.body: The top bar now shows the faces of who’s on right now, updating as people come and go. Tap them to open the Active list.

items.title: See someone’s picture
items.body: Tap a person’s picture in their task list or on their profile to see it big, in their frame, with a quick way to their profile.

items.title: One task, many people
items.body: On a project, choose several people (or the whole team) for a new task. Each person gets their own copy, so you don’t have to add it again for everyone.

title: A warm welcome

items.title: Good to have you here!
items.body: Signing in now opens with a short welcome: a little dance, a hello by name, and the time of day. Tap Let’s go to start, or Don’t show this again to turn it off on this device.

items.title: Notifications glide to their page
items.body: Opening a notification, a pop-up note or a release note now moves to its page with a soft fade, while the menu and top bar stay put.

title: Tidier resources and a smoother map

items.title: Cleaner resource cards
items.body: Each card now shows the title in full width with one Preview button. Open in Google, Download and Copy link are under the ⋯ button next to the pencil.

items.title: Show all places
items.body: The fit button on the Live Map now frames just the places on the map, instead of zooming far out for a far-away check-in or site.

items.title: A smoother side panel
items.body: Folding the Live Map panel away or back is smooth now: the map stays still as the panel slides, and the button no longer jumps when you press it.

title: The portal is now PRISM

items.title: A new name: PRISM
items.body: PRISM stands for Response, Inventory and Staff Management. It is the same system, with the same sign-in and everything you have already done.

items.title: A new logo
items.body: One beam of light goes into a prism and comes out as three colours: one system, three jobs made clear. You will see it in the menu, on the sign-in page and on the browser tab.

items.title: Installed on your phone?
items.body: The home-screen icon and name change to PRISM after this update. On some phones they only change once you remove the app and add it to the home screen again.

title: Staff Tasks fits beside the menu

items.title: Your progress stays on the right
items.body: On a laptop with the menu open, Staff Tasks now keeps its lists on the left, your tasks in the middle and your level, week and team goal on the right, instead of pushing them above and below.

items.title: Sign out from your profile
items.body: Sign out has moved off the side menu. Open your picture at the top right and choose Sign out.

title: Light mode, a clearer look and a better calendar

items.title: Light or dark
items.body: Choose Dark, Light or Auto (follows your device) in your profile or the account menu.

items.title: A calmer, clearer look
items.body: One main colour, one accent and plain icons everywhere. The welcome band is back at the top of Home with its moving background, and the main buttons shine when you point at them and press in when you tap.

items.title: A better calendar
items.body: Full weeks, today and your chosen day stand out, tasks show on their dates, and the agenda sits beside it. Swipe or use the arrow keys to change month.

items.title: Tasks that need a photo
items.body: Whoever gives a task can switch on “Needs a photo”: it can only be finished with a photo sent. On any other task, a photo earns +5 XP.

items.title: Your week in seven circles
items.body: Staff Tasks shows Monday to Sunday, filled on each day you finished a task. Finish one every working day for +25 XP.

items.title: Simpler words
items.body: “My Day” is now “Today”: the tasks you plan to do today.

items.title: A ting for notifications
items.body: A soft sound when a new notification arrives. Turn it off in the account menu.

items.title: Inventory words match the IMS
items.body: Stock is “running low” at or under its low-stock level, as the IMS says it.

items.title: Every update in the bell
items.body: Each version’s news now has its own note in the bell, with its version number.

title: Avatar frames and a tidier profile

items.title: Avatar frames
items.body: 20 animated rings for your profile picture. Some are earned with levels, and administrators wear the PHILRADS Admin crown.

items.title: Public or private profile
items.body: A small switch at the end of your profile decides who sees your details.

items.title: Profile fits its space
items.body: Tap your photo to change it. Home leads with a bigger calendar.

items.title: Project costs
items.body: Projects show their total cost, and completed projects count in Statistics.

items.title: Who gave each task
items.body: The Active list shows who gave each person their tasks.

title: Search, who’s online and Staff Tasks

items.title: Search anything
items.body: Pages, people, tasks, projects, statistics and resources, from the top bar.

items.title: Your status
items.body: Online, idle, do not disturb or invisible, and the Active list of who’s on, by role, beside every page.

items.title: Give and finish tasks
items.body: Give a task to anyone; tasks from the same or a lower role are accepted or declined first. Start and Finish on each row, with an optional note, links and photos.

items.title: Notifications
items.body: All or Unread, Today and Earlier, pop-ups as notes arrive, and notifications on your phone.

items.title: Quick unlock
items.body: A 6-digit PIN and fingerprint or face on this device.

items.title: Sign forms on screen
items.body: Every signature spot can be signed on screen, and typed text can be made bigger or smaller.

items.title: Smoother motion
items.body: Pull to refresh, rolling numbers, drag to reorder and a success tick.

items.title: Verse of the Day
items.body: Read more opens a short reflection, something to do today and a prayer.

title: Private funding, spreadsheet sync and smoother motion

items.title: Funding is private
items.body: Funding amounts and donors on Statistics are now visible only to administrators and coordinators.

items.title: Sync from the statistics workbook
items.body: Drop the Excel file on Statistics, choose this month or this year, check every change, then apply. Nothing is ever deleted.

items.title: Top donors
items.body: Who supported the most activities this month, this year or since 2023, by funding or by number of activities.

items.title: Switches that feel real
items.body: On/off settings stretch, overshoot and settle, like a real switch.

items.title: Smoother tabs and lists
items.body: Tab highlights glide to your choice, and a deleted row slides away while the rest move up, so you never lose your place.

items.title: See your password
items.body: An eye button shows what you typed when signing in, and a wrong password gives the card a little shake.

items.title: A sound when something goes wrong
items.body: A wrong password or an action that fails now plays a sound. Turn it off under Sound on errors in the account menu.

items.title: What’s new, right here
items.body: Each update now shows what it brings before you install it. You’ll also find it in the bell and the account menu.

title: Statistics and a new app icon

items.title: Statistics
items.body: Every PHILRADS project and activity since 2023: where, when and who was served, also shown on the Live Map.

items.title: Browse Drive folders in Resources
items.body: Open a shared folder inside the preview, choose files and download them.

items.title: New app icon
items.body: The portal also signs you out after 10 minutes without activity, to keep shared phones safe.

items.title: Chat is coming
items.body: It has a place in the sidebar already, marked Soon.

title: Forms, Projects and profiles

items.title: Forms
items.body: PHILRADS templates to fill in on screen and print, each on the right paper.

items.title: Projects
items.body: Programs and projects with milestones, reports, team, tasks and documentation.

items.title: Relief events from the portal
items.body: Create relief events on Response and approve them; the IMS confirms them.

items.title: Live Map upgrades
items.body: Temperature over land and sea, full screen, and faster live sharing with a floating bubble.

items.title: Profiles
items.body: A profile card with your level and badges, and photos you can drag and zoom before saving.

items.title: Calendars
items.body: A new look, weekends set apart, and Philippine holidays for 2026 and 2027.

items.title: Team tasks
items.body: See the whole team’s tasks, and mark a task In progress.
